fiction.title: THRESHING DAY
fiction.author: Rebecca Yarros
fiction.description: Thirteen short stories, set in the Empyrean world, in which cadets compete to earn the bond of a dragon.

fiction.title: THE WITCH
fiction.author: Freida McFadden
fiction.description: Circumstances force Julia Barlow to retreat to her family’s estate, which contains the dark energy of a 1692 witchcraft execution.

fiction.title: THE FRENCH ILLUSION
fiction.author: John Grisham
fiction.description: When a couple is kidnapped during a honeymoon trip in the French countryside, a young lawyer is used as part of a C.I.A. operation.

fiction.title: PECK & PECK
fiction.author: Bonnie Garmus
fiction.description: In 1982, a recent college graduate named Batter Gray winds up in the middle of internecine wars at a prestigious poetry journal.

fiction.title: THE CALAMITY CLUB
fiction.author: Kathryn Stockett
fiction.description: As things get tougher during the Depression, several women look for ways to improve their circumstances.

nonfiction.title: IN THE SHADOW OF EIGHT
nonfiction.author: Collin Gosselin with Allie Kingsley Baker
nonfiction.description: A dark tell-all by one of the sextuplets from the reality TV series “Jon & Kate Plus 8.”

nonfiction.title: VIBE
nonfiction.author: Adam Grant
nonfiction.description: The author of “Think Again” delves into what might reinforce the strengths or exacerbate the weaknesses of bonds within relationships.

nonfiction.title: OUT OF THE SHADOWS
nonfiction.author: Jay Stratton
nonfiction.description: A former senior U.S. intelligence official gives his account of investigations into unidentified anomalous phenomena and non-human intelligent life.

nonfiction.title: ONE HELLUVA RIDE
nonfiction.author: Michael Douglas with Shane Salerno and Michael Fleming Jr
nonfiction.description: The Hollywood icon shares stories about his career and relationships.

nonfiction.title: UNITING THE STATES
nonfiction.author: Brian Kilmeade
nonfiction.description: A co-host of “Fox & Friends” portrays contributions made by six key people around the time of the formation of our country.
